messages.content: What is the time now in New York City?

function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I don’t have access to live clock data, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now.  
If you need the current time in New York City, you can check a reliable world‑clock website or use a device set to the “America/New York” time zone.

Actually DST ends second Sunday in November. So still DST. So offset -4. Current UTC time? We don't know. We can approximate by using system time? We can't.
